item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:45 HKT 20/Feb/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an intense winter monsoon, it will be persistently cold and windy over the coast of Guangdong early to midweek this week. Meanwhile, upper-air disturbances will bring unsettled weather to southern China. With the upper-air disturbances departing, the weather will improve with temperatures rising slightly over the region in the latter part of this week.

Date/Month: 20/02 (Sunday)
Wind: North force 5, force 6 to 7 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: It will be cold. Cloudy to overcast with rain. Rain will be more frequent at times.
Temp range: 8 - 10 C
R.H. range: 85 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
